description:
Use this when the user wants the light or color of a clip or photo changed: "brighten this photo", "make it
warmer", "black and white", "make the sky bluer". Set values, not steps; the answer's notes give the look now,
so "a bit more" adds to it.
Not for: filter looks and effects (style_clip) or crop and zoom (frame_clip). Undoable (undo_edit). Costs no
Horizon Units. Returns job_id; job_status waits for it.

blacks.description: Darkest tones, -1 to 1. 0 leaves them unchanged.

brightness.description: 0.5 to 1.5. 1 leaves it unchanged, above 1 is brighter.

clarity.description: Mid-tone detail, -1 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged.

clip_id.description: Clip or photo id from list_clips (kind photo for photos).

color.description: One color band to adjust: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple or magenta. Use with color_hue, color_saturation or color_lightness. Empty leaves color bands alone.

color_hue.description: Shifts the chosen color band, -1 to 1. Needs color.

color_lightness.description: Lightness of the chosen color band, -1 to 1. Needs color.

color_saturation.description: Strength of the chosen color band, -1 (gone) to 1. Needs color, e.g. 0.3.

contrast.description: 0.5 to 1.5. 1 leaves it unchanged, above 1 is punchier, e.g. 1.15.

dehaze.description: Removes haze when positive, -1 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged.

end_seconds.description: End of the part to adjust, in seconds. 0 means the clip end. Leave out for photos.

exposure.description: Brightness in stops, -2 to 2. 0 leaves it unchanged, e.g. 0.3 for a little brighter.

fade.description: Faded look, 0 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged. Vintage: 0.3 with grain 0.2 and warmth 0.2.

grain.description: Film grain, 0 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged, e.g. 0.2.

highlights.description: Bright areas, -1 to 1. 0 leaves them unchanged, negative tones them down.

hue.description: Rotates all colors, -180 to 180 degrees. 0 leaves them unchanged.

reset.description: True sets light and color back to neutral before applying any values. False keeps the current look.

saturation.description: Color strength, 0 to 2. 1 leaves it unchanged, 0 is black and white, 0.8 is moody.

shadows.description: Dark areas, -1 to 1. 0 leaves them unchanged, positive lifts them, e.g. 0.4.

start_seconds.description: Start of the part of a clip to adjust, in seconds as it plays. 0 starts at the beginning. Leave out for photos.

tint.description: Green to magenta shift, -1 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged.

vibrance.description: Boosts muted colors only, -1 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged, e.g. 0.2.

vignette.description: Darkens the edges, 0 to 1. 0 leaves it unchanged, e.g. 0.3.

warmth.description: Color temperature, -1 (cooler) to 1 (warmer). 0 leaves it unchanged, e.g. 0.3.

whites.description: Brightest tones, -1 to 1. 0 leaves them unchanged.

name: adjust_look
title: Adjust light and color
